html:
The Kullilla were an Aboriginal Australian people of southwest Queensland, in the Bulloo River country around today's Thargomindah. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

Their land is semi-arid, with a river that flows only after rain and a chain of lakes and waterholes. Little is recorded of them. Neighbours on the map include the Karenggapa, the Badjiri and the Wangkumara. Pastoral stations reached the Bulloo in the 1860s and 1870s. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
